 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION (FOR CANCELLATION OF BAIL) NO.

 HIRAL D/O DALPATBHAI PARMAR  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 MS HEMABEN A MISTRY(12678) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR HK PATEL, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HASMUKH D. SUTHAR  Date : 09/05/2025  ORAL ORDER [1.0] RULE.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of notice of Rule for and on behalf of respondent No.1 - State of Gujarat.

[2.0] By way of the present application under Section 483(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (for short "BNSS), the applicant has prayed to cancel the anticipatory bail granted to respondent No.2 by this Court vide order dated 19.03.2025 in Criminal Misc. Application No.5805 of 2025 in connection with the FIR being C.R. No.11208035250112 of 2025 registered with Gandhigram Police Station, Rajkot for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2), 376(c), 418 and 506(2) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
[3.0] Heard learned advocate for the applicant and learned APP for respondent No.1 - State of Gujarat.
[4.0] Herein the offence against respondent No.2 is under Sections 376(2), 376(c), 418 and 506(2)
of the IPC but no offence is NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/9718/2025 ORDER DATED:
09/05/2025 undefined registered for the offence under Section 376(AB), or 376(DA), 376(DB) of the IPC and the victim is major and nor minor.

Considering the aforesaid fact, there is no bar under Hiral D/O Dalpatbhai Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111511715/
1 Section 376(3) of the IPC and hence, the argument canvassed by the learned advocate for the applicant that notice was not issued to the original complainant or the victim would not sustain and therefore, question does not arise to issue notice prior to considering the bail application.
[5.0] Further, the criteria of grant and cancellation of bail is different and no any other supervening circumstances prevail or exist and therefore also, no case is made out for cancellation of bail and hence, present application is dismissed.

sentences.text: However, if any supervening circumstances arise then the liberty is reserved in favor of the applicant to file appropriate proceeding.

[6.0] In view of the above, no case is made out to entertain the present application and hence,
present application stands dismissed in limine.
It is made clear that this Court has not gone into the merits.

(HASMUKH D. SUTHAR, J.) Ajay Hiral D/O Dalpatbhai Parmar vs State Of Gujarat on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111511715/
